# HMCL built-in wallpaper

GCL's `DefaultBackground.jpg` is an unchanged copy of HMCL's `2021-08-26.jpg`, the birch-coast/sheep scene selected by the user.

Upstream project: https://github.com/HMCL-dev/HMCL
Source file: https://github.com/HMCL-dev/HMCL/blob/main/HMCL/src/main/resources/assets/img/wallpapers/2021-08-26.jpg
Upstream path introduced at commit: 28022461f7665720889d006ce14e671519d80de7
Retrieved: 2026-10-27
SHA-256: 0514620c55e7344a525a8ec511e458aeddb65b7e8f083ec61ad98d74fb9c8b36

The image belongs to its original authors and is not GCL-created artwork. The upstream repository's GPL-3.0 license and HMCL additional terms are preserved verbatim in `HMCL-LICENSE.txt`. The source image is supplied with this project's source; the app About page links to its upstream location. GCL uses its own application name, icon and implementation and is not an official HMCL build.
